title: H1621 (2025 Regular): Offenses Involving Firearms with Bump Stocks

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2025-02-28; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2025/1621/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 3148545))
provenance.note: Introduced text (filed 2025-02-28). In s. 790.001(13) 'which' and 'function' are struck and 'that:' and 'pull' added. Section 2 adds one row to the offence severity chart, referring to s. 790.222, which is not created by this bill. No vote recorded.

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.001, F.S.): "Machine gun" means any firearm that: (a) Shoots, or is designed to shoot, automatically more than one shot, without manually reloading, by a single pull of the trigger; or (b) Is modified by a conversion kit, a tool, an accessory, or a device that is used to alter the rate of fire of the firearm to mimic automatic weapon fire or that is used to increase the rate of fire to a faster rate than is possible for a person to fire such firearm unassisted by a conversion kit, a tool, an accessory, or a device by a single pull of the trigger.
Section 2 (s. 921.0022, F.S.): 790.222 3rd Prohibited acts related to bump-fire stocks.
